title: Cooking with Gloria: Ambrosia Salad (Happy 4th of July)
description:
🎉 Happy 4th of July, everyone! 🎉

As we celebrate this joyous day of independence and unity, I wanted to share a delicious recipe that has become a staple in my family's 4th of July celebrations: Ambrosia Salad! 🥗✨

This Ambrosia Salad is not only a crowd-pleaser, but it's also a colorful addition to any 4th of July gathering. 🎇🌟 Feel free to customize it by adding your favorite fruits or even a dash of coconut milk for a tropical twist!

Wishing you all a fantastic Independence Day filled with laughter, good food, and cherished moments with your loved ones. Stay safe, have fun, and let freedom ring! 🎆💙❤️💙
